verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Incident Response/IRM product explicitly supports on-call schedules, alert escalation, and incident coordination from declaration through post-incident review, with in-incident investigation tied to metrics/logs/traces. This is well documented first-party but lacks independent hands-on corroboration of the incident/timeline workflow specifically. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of the incident timeline and escalation features specifically (community evidence only covers alerting/dashboards broadly, plus one comment noting incident management as a newer, less mature add-on).
